0022600118.text: The Kings are 0-2 at home after a 0-1 start, sitting 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West, while the Grizzlies are 2-0 and 5th in the West on a two-game winning streak. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Memphis is without Zach Edey (ankle), with Cedric Coward listed as day-to-day with a wrist sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Kings lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, and their last meeting was a 123-114 Sacramento win in Memphis on February 23, 2026.
